Featured project · 01

NEXORA

Microsoft AI Enterprise Agentic Copilot

A Microsoft AI-powered conversational application that combines enterprise document retrieval and SQL analytics. The LLM selects tools to answer questions using structured data, source-grounded document context, or both.

Built with multimodal-aware ingestion, hybrid retrieval, semantic reranking, authentication, document-level access filtering, and containerized deployment workflows.

A little about me

From data science
to AI systems.

My background bridges data science, machine learning, data engineering, and cloud infrastructure. Across research and technology environments, I've worked on speech recognition, NLP, analytics, data pipelines, model deployment, and Kubernetes-based workflows.

Today, my engineering focus is Generative AI, agentic applications, advanced RAG, and Microsoft AI systems. I care about building beyond the prototype: retrieval quality, source grounding, security boundaries, deployment, and maintainable architecture.
